text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: One day, showing up at training track...

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Ready then, Doto-san? Doing your fortune 
right away, okay?

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Y-Yes-ish. Um... for race luck... 
please...

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Understood! Let's get right into it!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Divination start~! Mmmmmmm!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Uuu... God, Goddess, Fukukitaru-sama. 
Please, great fortune...

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: ............ ...F-Fukukitaru-san?

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
C-C-C-Could that expression mean my 
fortune reading is... ngh.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: To be blunt, terrible luck---!!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Hyaaawaaaaahhhhhh--!!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
However, depending on your mindset 
afterward, it could become great luck...

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Wait, you're not listening at all--?!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Uwaaaahhhhh! I knew it... no matter what I 
do, I'm just hopeless~...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Meisho Doto dashed away at full speed... 
onto the 2000m turf course.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Rounding the first and second corners... 
heading straight for the goal...!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Awawawa...!! What do we do?! Where is a 
helping hand for this lost Horse Girl?!
choice_data_list: There's no need to panic that much

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Pyaaah?! Could you be an envoy from the 
gods?!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Trainer or not, it doesn't matter! Please, 
grant me your guidance!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
A fortune isn't complete until the true 
result is told! What should I do about 
Doto-san...?!
choice_data_list: I think we should just wait here
Let's call out to her loudly!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Wait?! Sit back and await heavenly fate?! 
But Doto-san has already started 
sprinting—

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: All the way around the course...

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
...Passing the third corner, and coming 
right back our way...?

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
*pant* *gasp*... *pant*. I-I'm so 
exhausted~...

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: NOW'S OUR CHANCE! CATCH HEEERR!!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Fueeeh?! Fukukitaru-san?! Why are you 
here?! Did you teleport~?!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, having run a full lap back on her 
own, Meisho Doto was finally able to hear 
her true fortune reading.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
W-What?! But Doto-san is already far off 
in the distance!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
I don't know if screaming now will even 
reach her...
choice_data_list: You won't know until you try

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I decided to also grant Matikanefukukitaru 
a certain secret strategy.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Ugh~... I'll give it a shot regardless! 
*inhallllle*!!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Whoever wants great luck, touch this 
finger!!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: She actually came...?!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
B-Because... if I can get great luck, of 
course I want it... ngh.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
If something good will definitely happen 
someday, I feel like I could finally have 
confidence...

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
I want someone to give me a push and say 
even someone as useless as me can do it... 
ngh!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
...! Yes, yes. It's alright, something 
great will definitely happen to you!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: R-Really...?

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Of course! Because your original fortune 
was great luck in the first place!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"I want to gain confidence." The sheer 
intensity of Meisho Doto's feelings struck 
a chord somewhere deep within...

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: It didn't work after all!!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
KIEEE--!! If it's come to this, all-out 
warfare! Everyone, let's catch Doto-san 
together!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, enlisting help from various 
people, we set out to chase down Meisho 
Doto—

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Fueeeeeeeeh?! They're chasing me from over 
there and over here too~~?!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: S-S-S... SOMEBODY SAVE MEEEE~~!!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
*pant*... *pant*... To get this... 
exhausted...

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
It's not just bad luck after all, it's 
absolute worst luck~...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
We somehow managed to catch Meisho Doto, 
who was completely exhausted...
